advancement.starfold.ship.root.title: Build a ship
advancement.starfold.ship.root.descripti: Dig grey speckled andesite in the first forty blocks under soil. Open this tab to follow the build.
advancement.starfold.ship.andesite.title: Find andesite
advancement.starfold.ship.andesite.descr: Mix 2 andesite with 2 iron nuggets to make alloy. Gather 14 andesite for the workshop.
advancement.starfold.ship.alloy.title: Make andesite alloy
advancement.starfold.ship.alloy.descript: Use alloy on an axe-stripped log for casing. Craft shafts, a hand crank and a mechanical press.
advancement.starfold.ship.press.title: Build a hand press
advancement.starfold.ship.press.descript: Connect the crank to the press shaft. Drop an iron ingot below the press and turn the crank.
advancement.starfold.ship.sheet.title: Press an iron sheet
advancement.starfold.ship.sheet.descript: Craft Super Glue with an iron sheet, an iron nugget and 2 slimeballs to join hull blocks.
advancement.starfold.ship.glue.title: Make Super Glue
advancement.starfold.ship.glue.descripti: Craft a Physics Assembler: 2 alloys, casing and a lever. Glue only the hull, not the ground.
advancement.starfold.ship.assembler.desc: Glue hull blocks, then hold right-click and pull the assembler lever to make a ship. Add thrusters next.
advancement.starfold.ship.thruster.title: Point the nozzles
message.starfold.insufficient_lift: Insufficient lift: downward nozzles cannot carry the current ship weight.
advancement.starfold.ship.thruster.descr: Down nozzles lift: lift must exceed weight. Fit balanced pairs about the mass centre. Gyros do not cancel weight.
advancement.starfold.ship.gyro.title: Power the gyro
advancement.starfold.ship.gyro.descripti: Use at least two gyros, each with its lever on. They steady the hull, not unbalanced thrust. Point the helm at the bow.
advancement.starfold.ship.helm.title: Fit the helm
advancement.starfold.ship.helm.descripti: Right-click: fly; R: leave. Light hulls overshoot: add a floor layer. Tested: six cobble layers. Stay aboard in space.
advancement.starfold.ship.scope.title: Fit flight instruments
advancement.starfold.ship.scope.descript: Fit a navigation scope before your first planet trip: it provides target lock. Fit an airstair under a door.
advancement.starfold.ship.airstair.title: Fit an airstair
advancement.starfold.ship.airstair.descr: Fit under a door, facing out. Keep door and ramp approach clear. Stop within 10 blocks of ground to deploy; Space lifts.
advancement.starfold.ship.lift_off.title: Lift off
advancement.starfold.ship.lift_off.descr: You lifted a piloted hull off the ground. Keep climbing with Space to reach space; Shift descends.
advancement.starfold.ship.space.title: Reach space
advancement.starfold.ship.space.descript: Space top speed depends on forward thrusters and hull mass: more engines are faster, heavier ships slower.
advancement.starfold.ship.other_planet.d: You landed on another planet. Fly back to the home planet and use its saved launch marker to find your base.
advancement.starfold.ship.home.title: Come home
advancement.starfold.ship.home.descripti: You returned and landed on the home planet. Wait for the airstair to deploy before leaving the helm.
